new_helpers.literal_source_statement: theorem mate_reverse (i : Fin d) (u v : V) : F.mate i u = v ↔ F.mate i v = u
theorem reverse (u v : V) : b.directed v u = inverseScalar (b.directed u v)

theorem directed_mate (u : Fin m) (i : Fin d) :
    b.directed u (F.mate i u) =
      if i = ⟨0, by omega⟩ then (if b.colour u then 1 else 2)
      else if i = ⟨1, by omega⟩ then (if b.colour u then 2 else 1) else 0

theorem scalar_colour_identity : ∀ (z : Bool) (x : Four),
    scalar (if z then 1 else 2) x + scalar (if z then 2 else 1) x = x

theorem scalar_colour_sum (u : Fin m) (x : Four) :
    (∑ v ∈ G.neighborFinset u, scalar (outgoingSlope G (chosenSlopes G b) u v) x) =
    d • x + x

theorem chosen_open_scalar (h : Odd d) (u : Fin m) (x : Four) :
    (∑ v ∈ G.neighborFinset u, scalar (outgoingSlope G (chosenSlopes G b) u v) x) = 0

theorem chosen_closed_scalar (h : Even d) (u : Fin m) (x : Four) :
    x + (∑ v ∈ G.neighborFinset u, scalar (outgoingSlope G (chosenSlopes G b) u v) x) = 0

theorem chosen_lift_open [Nonempty (Fin m)] (S : ColouredSeed G n d false)
    (hd : 4 ≤ d) (hodd : Odd d) :
    ∃ c : OrientedEdge G → Four,
      incidenceB G (chosenSlopes G S.colouring) c = 0 ∧
      c ∉ (incidenceD G (chosenSlopes G S.colouring)).range ∧
      (affineTransport G (chosenSlopes G S.colouring) c).graph.IsRegularOfDegree d ∧
      OpenMagic (affineTransport G (chosenSlopes G S.colouring) c).graph (n+2)

theorem chosen_lift_closed [Nonempty (Fin m)] (S : ColouredSeed G n d true)
    (hd : 4 ≤ d) (heven : Even d) :
    ∃ c : OrientedEdge G → Four,
      incidenceB G (chosenSlopes G S.colouring) c = 0 ∧
      c ∉ (incidenceD G (chosenSlopes G S.colouring)).range ∧
      (affineTransport G (chosenSlopes G S.colouring) c).graph.IsRegularOfDegree d ∧
      ClosedMagic (affineTransport G (chosenSlopes G S.colouring) c).graph (n+2)

theorem chosen_open_exists [Nonempty (Fin m)] (S : ColouredSeed G n d false)
    (hd : 4 ≤ d) (hodd : Odd d) : OpenExists (n+2) d

theorem chosen_closed_exists [Nonempty (Fin m)] (S : ColouredSeed G n d true)
    (hd : 4 ≤ d) (heven : Even d) : ClosedExists (n+2) d

theorem omegaWalk_step {u v : Fin m} (p : G.Walk u v)
    (h : OmegaWalk G (chosenSlopes G b) p) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < p.length) :
    b.directed (p.getVert i) (p.getVert (i+1)) = 1

theorem FactorColouring.directed_lift (a : FactorColouring D he) (T : EdgeTransport H)
    {p q : V × Four} (hpq : T.graph.Adj p q) :
    (a.lift T).directed p q = a.directed p.1 q.1

theorem chosen_seed_lift_data [Nonempty (Fin m)] {closed : Bool}
    (S : ColouredSeed G n d closed) (hd : 4 ≤ d)
    (hparity : if closed then Even d else Odd d)
    (hcomp : ∀ c : OrientedEdge G → Four,
      LiftComplementInput G (chosenSlopes G S.colouring) c d) :
    ∃ c : OrientedEdge G → Four,
      Nonempty (ColouredLiftSeed (affineTransport G (chosenSlopes G S.colouring) c).graph (n+2) d closed)
